subject: [hw] DONE IP rev 7: 765 checks; large-AU output sizing; shas e465.../81a6...
body:
DONE IP rev 7 (supersedes rev 6 product shas). Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published, no commit.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 765/765
    249/249 ASan+UBSan, 249/249 -O2, 249/249 TSan; 18/18 real (real vpud OPEN_OK on a 64x48 session).
  bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh -> IOS BUILD OK
    vcodecd 391648 B sha256 e465bba0f0df13f87986bc8f982592405ac2b512126d8523da2bb1bf7eb673d5
    n2vcd_cli 70000 B sha256 b62f3cbe6d646207a5064a6b381ff0742ca677acb4177f29ba58b79f302637b0
  bash gpu/hwcodec/ios/build.sh -> IOS TOOLS OK
    vcodecd 386048 B sha256 81a6590f3ccceb152f69eae7902210846dc82a20eb2bc79584bb27d3959b3fd7
    n2vcd_probe 68736, n2vcd_selftest 368272
  bash gpu/hwcodec/install/stage.sh dev --host-test -> STAGE HOST TEST OK

Since rev 6: OPEN_OK.out_buf_bytes now advertises a full NV12-sized AU allowance (w*h*3/2, 1..16 MiB, +64 KiB) instead of w*h/2, so a large 1080p key frame cannot be rejected by the old ~1 MiB cap. --venc-slow stays removed; slbc_ready=0; both vcodecd have the V32/V33 shims, no fake symbols, --gate, fatal exit 70. F14-F21 fixed; P04 objects compiled. Full detail: gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/IP/STATUS.md.
